claims.statement: Ezra records Cyrus authorizing a return and the rebuilding of the LORD’s house in Jerusalem.
Nehemiah describes public reading and explanation of the Law followed by understanding, worship, and renewed communal response.
Taken together, these passages support the lesson’s big idea: Return from exile fulfilled real promises but did not complete the biblical hope.
